summary: C2 pre-parser timeout classification is separate from proof of retry eligibility. A retained diagnostic projection can identify an observed startup class while lacking the complete input and owner counterparts required for a new retry. The prepared source guard requires exact original deadline, argv, resource and endpoint joins, positive original-server listener ownership, qualified cleanup with no residual or additional failure, and fresh original file-pin, alias and optional toolchain archive checks inside the original reporting deadline. Missing, malformed, changed or oversized evidence and any parser/state/invariant output refuse. This class shares the existing global maximum of two attempts with the parser and early-lifecycle classes; it cannot add a third attempt or renew an old operation. The second attempt uses a fresh endpoint. C2 runs after the canonical Quint receipt and its local retry markers represent separate physical work, not canonical startupRetries counters. Whole-job planning must include both lanes and cleanup plus Q1/Q2, Rust controls, traces, parity and collection; observed timings are not hard bounds for otherwise unbounded subprocesses. The source controls use synthetic complete data and do not establish the cause of any observed startup stall, formal correctness, runtime qualification or delivery.
title: C2 startup retry requires complete current custody and input evidence
